reproduction_target: Reproduce the computational results of the NIBIT-M4 epi-immunotherapy melanoma study: snRNA+snATAC multiome processing and multimodal clustering, malignant metaprogram (NMF) discovery and characterization, eGRN inference (SCENIC+), Visium HD spatial segmentation/annotation and the custom spatial statistics (PLI, TSPS, ecotypes), transposable-element quantification and TE-TAA discovery, and the external-cohort prognostic/survival validation. Wet-lab sample collection, 10x library preparation and sequencing are out of scope (OOS).
granularity_note: Stage-1 prose triage. No code repository is stated anywhere in the paper, so no workflow file exists to anchor granularity; steps were derived one-per-named-tool/analysis-invocation from the Methods section (JATS XML, offsets 111026-158290). 40 computational steps + 3 wet-lab steps. Custom, un-named-tool analyses (PLI, TSPS, optimal transport, ecotypes, tumor region identification, TE-TAA workflow) are counted as one step each because each is a separately named analysis with its own parameters.

steps.label: Sample collection - 13 snap-frozen tumor biopsies from 5 patients, phase Ib NIBIT-M4 trial (NCT02608437), longitudinal week 0/4/12
10x Genomics Single-Nucleus Multiome (RNA+ATAC) library preparation (CG000505 Rev A, CG000338 Rev F) and NovaSeq X Plus sequencing
Visium HD CytAssist FFPE spatial gene expression library preparation (CG000518 Rev C, CG00685 Rev A) and NovaSeq X Plus sequencing
Multiome read mapping and count matrix generation - Cell Ranger ARC v2.0.2, reference refdata-cellranger-arc-GRCh38-2020-A-2.0.0
snRNA-seq modality QC, normalization, PCA (3000 HVG), t-SNE (22 PCs), clustering (res 0.2) - Seurat v5.1.0
snATAC-seq modality processing - peak merging via GenomicRanges v1.54.1 reduce, QC filters, TF-IDF, SVD/LSI (2:50), SLM clustering res 0.8 - Signac v1.14.0
ATAC peak calling and gene activity scoring - MACS2 v2.2.6 via Signac CallPeaks, GeneActivity
RNA+ATAC multimodal integration - Seurat FindMultiModalNeighbors WNN (RNA PC 1:14, ATAC LSI 2:50), WSNN SLM clustering res 0.1, n=38029 nuclei
Malignant vs non-malignant cell discrimination - SCEVAN v1.0.3 (CNA-based clone inference)
TME cell-type annotation - non-malignant clustering (12 PCs, res 0.7) + marker signatures + Mann-Whitney-Wilcoxon Gene Set Test NES (implementation and version not named)

Malignant metaprogram identification - NMF over k=4..9 (468 programs), robustness filtering (70% intra-sample overlap, <=20% redundancy, <=20% cross-patient), Jaccard iterative hierarchical clustering; NMF implementation/package not named
Malignant cell assignment to MP states - Seurat AddModuleScore (50-gene signatures), score>0.3, simplicity score>=0.1
MP functional characterization - hypergeometric ORA + GSEA with clusterProfiler v4.10.1 on memento v0.1.1 differential expression (de_coef >= |ln2|, padj<0.05); GO/Reactome/KEGG/Hallmark/WikiPathways
Cell-cell communication between MP-stratified malignant cells and TME - CellChat v2.1.2
Cross-modal concordance - Seurat v5.1.0 FindTransferAnchors (CCA) / TransferData (LSI 2:50), RNA reference to ATAC gene-activity query
Comparison of MPs with published melanoma signatures - Seurat AddModuleScore + Pearson correlation
TF motif enrichment and footprinting - Signac MatchRegionStats + FindMotifs on DA peaks (log2FC>=0.58, padj<0.05), HOCOMOCO v13 PWMs, fold-enrichment>=1.3, top-30 union; Footprint on GRCh38/hg38
CRE-TF-gene linkage - mapping of motif-containing regions to ENCODE cCRE PLS/pELS/dELS (release not stated) and ORA with clusterProfiler enricher
Enhancer-driven GRN inference - SCENIC+ v1.0a2 Snakemake pipeline with default parameters, pycisTopic v2.0a0, pycisTarget v1.1, AUCell; eRegulon filtering |r|>0.3, top-30 triple ranking

Visium HD nuclei segmentation and barcode binning - StarDist pre-trained model (version/model name not stated) on H&E, 8x8 um bin aggregation to per-nucleus counts, custom binning procedure repeated over 9 samples
Visium HD preprocessing - cell/gene QC (mito>5%, <5 genes, genes in <5 cells), CP10K total-count normalization, log2 transform, z-scaling; software not named
Visium HD malignant vs non-malignant discrimination - Louvain clustering (res 0.5) + cluster differential expression + manual marker-gene inspection; DE method and software not named
Optimal-transport annotation transfer snRNA-seq -> Visium HD - Fused Gromov-Wasserstein with spatial constraints (method cited only; no package, no cost/alpha/epsilon hyperparameters, no code)
Malignant/non-malignant spatial interaction analysis - custom radius-r neighbourhood counting with N=100 label permutations and Z-scores; radius r never given numerically, no code
Peripheral Localization Index (PLI) - custom convex-hull boundary distance statistic with K=500 random null samples; full formula given, no code
Tumor State Proximity Score (TSPS) - custom radius-r same-state neighbour fraction; radius r not specified, no code

Tumor region identification - custom Gaussian KDE intensity field, adaptive threshold tau=0.5, morphological closing/dilation, 0.5 isocontour polygons, area<100 discarded; KDE bandwidth and structuring elements not specified, no code
Within-sample local ecotype discovery - spatial kNN (k=50), one-hot composition, CLR transform, K-means (n=6 per sample); no code, no seed
Cross-sample consensus ecotypes - agglomerative hierarchical clustering on cosine distances, 25-threshold grid (10th-90th percentile), Calinski-Harabasz index maximization; no code
Transposable element annotation - UCSC RepeatMasker GRCh38/hg38 repeats retrieved via AnnotationHub v3.10.1 (snapshot date not stated); TE age from milliDiv / 2.2e-9 substitution rate
TE locus-level count/accessibility matrix generation - MATES (version not stated) on snRNA-seq and snATAC-seq, size-factor normalization, log transform, conversion to Seurat v5.1.0 objects
TE-based RNA/ATAC modality integration - Seurat v5.1.0 (TME: RNA PC 1-6 / ATAC PC 1-10; malignant: RNA PC 1-9 / ATAC PC 1-10)
TE differential expression and accessibility - scran v1.30.2 scoreMarkers (rank.AUC, logFC.cohen); significance thresholds not stated
TE annotation on cCRE elements - intersection of TE loci with MACS2 peaks, ENCODE cCREs (release not stated) and GeneHancer v4.4 enhancers; cCRE-gene links from ENCODE

TE-derived tumor-associated antigen (TE-TAA) discovery workflow - top-1% logFC.cohen TEs, custom R six-frame translation (ORF>=10 aa), BLASTp vs gEVE (both unversioned, >=95% identity, e<0.01), netMHCpan MHC-I binding (unversioned, alleles/thresholds not stated), antigen-quality/NRP metric

Bulk RNA-seq external cohort deconvolution - 8 ICI-treated melanoma cohorts (6 via TIGER, 1 via cBioPortal, 1 = GEO GSE168204); CIBERSORTx webserver with a custom signature matrix derived from this study's snRNA-seq (matrix not provided); tumor purity scaling with ESTIMATE v1.0.13
External scRNA-seq melanoma cohort MP scoring - EGA accession EGAS00001006488, 10th-percentile sample filter, 1% gene filter, Seurat AddModuleScore, assignment score>0.05
Survival analysis - median-split MP High/Low, Kaplan-Meier, log-rank, Cox PH forest plots; survival v3.5-7, survminer v0.5.0
Prognostic assessment of MP proportions - LOOCV generalized linear model with caret v6.0-94, ROC/AUC with pROC v1.18.5; model formula and predictor set only partially specified
In-silico TF perturbation - SCENIC+ perturbation workflow, 5 independent iterations, mean signature-expression difference vs baseline; no seed, perturbation magnitude not stated
GRN inference on external scRNA-seq melanoma dataset - pySCENIC v0.12.1+8.gd2309fe, regulon refinement at 90th-percentile target weight; cisTarget motif/ranking database version not stated, no seed
NFATC2 post-transcriptional activity - decoupleR v2.9.7 ULM regulon activity on bulk RNA-seq, activity subtracted from expression, LOOCV GLM + pROC ROC/AUC pre/post ICI

NFATC2 knockdown analysis - GEO GSE101323, differential expression with limma v3.58.1, GSEA over GO BP/KEGG/Reactome/WikiPathways/Hallmark, single-sample MWW-GST on top-50 up-regulated genes (MWW-GST implementation unversioned)

headline.static_readiness: 0/40 (0%) - stage1 ceiling only, no R-star (R-star needs stage-2 code verification)
headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: 25/40 (63%) readiness upper bound (n_R-star + n_RI)/|S| - 'ready for a reproduction attempt', never 'reproducible'. The 0/40 static_readiness under-claims by construction: Tier-1 cannot credit an undeclared-but-present dependency, and here there is no code repository at all to inspect at Stage 2.
headline.coverage: computational coverage |S|/(|S|+|W|) = 40/43 (93%); 3 wet-lab steps OOS (biopsy collection, 10x multiome library prep + sequencing, Visium HD library prep + sequencing)

gaps.missing: No Code Availability statement and no code repository of any kind (no GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/Zenodo/Software Heritage URL appears anywhere in the JATS full text, including back matter). The analysis code for a ~40-step multi-omic + spatial + TE pipeline is entirely undeposited.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the analysis code (R/Python scripts, SCENIC+ Snakemake config, custom spatial-statistics implementations) in a public repository with a versioned release DOI, and add a Code Availability statement.

gaps.where: Methods - Sample collection / 10X Multiome / Visium HD; whole paper
gaps.missing: No Data Availability statement. The primary data generated by this study - 13-sample snRNA+snATAC multiome and 9-sample Visium HD - carry no accession (no GEO/SRA/EGA/dbGaP identifier), and no controlled-access/DAC path is documented. Scored data=1 (missing identifier) rather than 0 (absent/lost) because the data plainly exists; a Stage-2 or post-publication check should re-adjudicate.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit raw and processed multiome + Visium HD data under a controlled-access archive (EGA/dbGaP, given human clinical-trial provenance) and state the accession plus the DAC application path.

gaps.where: C17, C19-C26, C32 (Visium HD binning, optimal transport, spatial interaction, PLI, TSPS, tumor region ID, ecotypes, TE-TAA workflow)
gaps.missing: Ten novel/custom analyses are described only in prose (several with formulas rendered as images) with no implementation released. These are the paper's methodological contributions and are the least reconstructable steps.
gaps.how_to_close: Release the custom scripts, or supply pseudocode plus all missing constants (neighbourhood radius r, KDE bandwidth, morphological kernel sizes, OT cost/alpha/epsilon).

gaps.where: gap subtype 2a (version not stated) - C7 (MWW-GST), C8 (NMF implementation), C17 (StarDist), C18 (preprocessing toolkit), C19 (Louvain/DE), C28 (MATES), C32 (BLASTp, netMHCpan, gEVE), C33 (CIBERSORTx webserver)
gaps.missing: Software named without any version string, or the tool itself not named (Visium HD preprocessing and Louvain clustering). 9 of 40 computational steps have version=0 on this basis.
gaps.how_to_close: State exact versions (and for StarDist, the pre-trained model identifier; for netMHCpan, the version and allele set; for CIBERSORTx, the run mode and date).

gaps.missing: No random seeds are stated anywhere for t-SNE, SLM/Louvain clustering, NMF (k=4..9, 468 programs), K-means (n=6), label permutation tests (N=100), null sampling (K=500), SCENIC+/pySCENIC, or the 5-iteration in-silico perturbation. Reproduction can only be distributional.
gaps.how_to_close: Record and publish seeds, or state explicitly that results are reported as distributional summaries over repeated runs.

gaps.missing: The custom signature matrix used as the deconvolution reference was generated from this study's snRNA-seq data and is not provided as a supplementary file; without it the external-cohort metaprogram composition (which drives the survival and prognostic results) cannot be recomputed.
gaps.how_to_close: Publish the CIBERSORTx signature matrix as a supplementary table.

gaps.missing: The SCENIC+ Snakemake pipeline is invoked 'with default parameters'; the pipeline config YAML, the cisTarget motif/ranking database build, and the pycisTopic topic-model selection are not shipped.
gaps.how_to_close: Ship the SCENIC+ config file and name the cisTarget database build (species, genome, feather file version).

gaps.missing: Two license-gated / registration-gated dependencies. CIBERSORTx is a web service whose exact behaviour at run time is not archivable by a third party; netMHCpan requires an academic licence and its version materially changes predictions.
gaps.how_to_close: Pin versions and, where licence allows, deposit the produced intermediate outputs (deconvolution fractions, peptide-binding tables) so downstream steps remain checkable.

gaps.where: C10/C15 (MSigDB/GO/Reactome/KEGG collections), C15 and C31 (ENCODE cCRE release), C16/C38 (cisTarget databases), C27 (AnnotationHub snapshot date), C32 (gEVE release)
gaps.missing: External reference resources are consumed without version pins. HOCOMOCO v13 (C14) and GeneHancer v4.4 (C31) ARE pinned; the remainder are not. With no workflow code, env_capture_class cannot be assigned (A/B/C is a Stage-2 classification).
gaps.how_to_close: State the release/date of every external annotation and gene-set database, and fetch them in code by versioned URL or DOI.

gaps.missing: Wet-lab steps (clinical-trial biopsy collection, 10x multiome library prep + NovaSeq X Plus sequencing, Visium HD CytAssist FFPE library prep + sequencing) are out of scope for computational reproducibility; they are documented at protocol-number level (10x CG000505 Rev A, CG000338 Rev F, CG000518 Rev C, CG00685 Rev A).
